name: syllabus-tracker
description: Competitive exam syllabus tracker: syllabus database (Phase 1), weightage (Phase 2), progress engine (Phase 3), common syllabus mapping with smart progress synchronization (Phase 4) and the smart preparation priority engine (Phase 5) for SSC & Banking.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-weightage.mjs && node scripts/build-mapping.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-weightage.mjs --check && node scripts/build-mapping.mjs --check
scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-weightage.mjs && node scripts/build-mapping.mjs --check && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
